invariants.rationale: Partition indices for buckets are always non-negative as they are used as indices and bucket identifiers.
The code assumes 'key' is not null as it is immediately cast and dereferenced.
The method always casts key to Pair, so it must be an instance of Pair.
The returned bucket number index should be less than the total number of buckets.
Combines the above bounds for a precise partition index range.
